notes: VERDICT: NOT CLEAN. 2 fails carry the weight: match_memory (blocker, RIFT as second match 3433-3461 MB against 3000, a plateau over the bar for the full 5 minutes) and audio_mix (major, probe hangs 3 of 3, context clock frozen). match_leave_journey is also a fail (2 of 3 runs). Blockers not measured: perf_realtime (92.1, 96.9, 95.6 %, all under 99, all busy), perf_gpubound_tail (58.5, 56.6, 57.5, 60 fps, all busy), e2e_all and e2e_flow (function passes, load clause missed). Also not measured: audio_sync, ge1_cost. Load: across the 5.5 hours the machine read about 2.2-3.8 even between runs, and a Chrome run pushes it over 3 (peaks 4-5.8). Top CPU at rest: booted iOS Simulator runtime processes (pids 26344, 26305, about 12-25 % each, left alone as instructed), diagnosticd, coreaudiod, sysmond, and at times TGOnDeviceInferenceProviderService, runningboardd and proactiveeventtrackerd. Timing gates that need a clean load<3 window are not reachable until that eases. How this was measured, which departs from the brief: the previous step's queue driver was still running when I started (pid 48158, orphaned, already running perf_prod). I did not kill a process I had not started and running alongside it would have spoiled both, so I let it finish (21:18-00:18) and read its raw logs, ignoring the claims. Names fw_final_idle_* are its output. Names fw_final_vfy_* are my own later runs of match memory, gpubound, calibrate, input latency, audio sync, e2e all, realtime, audio mix and lisvel seed 16. Gates with only fw_final_idle_* evidence were run once, by that driver, under the exact commands, not repeated by me. Things I ended or added: I ended my own stuck audio_mix rerun at 20 min, and my scratch diagnostic at 200 s. The driver's first audio_mix was killed by its own 1200 s limit. The diagnostic was a scratchpad copy of the probe with one log line; nothing under _harness was edited. Harness gap: perf_1080 --calibrate-only prints GATE PASS with no note at load 3.43->3.63. perf_1080 prints PASS inside a busy gpubound row. Tracked reports rewritten by runs were restored by the driver, with copies in _harness/_reports/fw_final_idle_snap and fw_final_vfy_snap.
